drafts_today.topic: Trail Bay moved: not today, Fri Nov 27 and Sun Nov 29
drafts_today.text:
If you were looking for me at Trail Bay today, I moved!

Come find me:
Fri Nov 27, 11 to 4
Sun Nov 29

Sample the RIMAN textures, ask me anything about skin after 40, and guess the candies in the tub to win a Multi Stick Balm, a facial, or both.

Which day suits you?
drafts_today.picture_tip: Your Trail Bay poster (the v7 with both dates) propped next to the candy tub and a Multi Stick Balm on your kitchen counter, daylight from a window.
drafts_today.video_tip: 6-8s clip: hand sets the candy tub down, then the Multi Stick Balm beside it. On-screen text: 'Moved! Nov 27 + 29, Trail Bay'.

drafts_today.topic: Less makeup after 50 (Parade 'Pamela Anderson rule' signal)
drafts_today.text:
After 50, more coverage isn't hiding anything. It settles into the lines.

Less is more:
1. Skincare first, let it settle
2. Sunscreen
3. A few dots of Sheer Glow BB, blended thin with fingertips
4. Glow Up Lip Oil
5. 1-2 sprays of Set & Stay

Save this for tomorrow morning.
drafts_today.picture_tip: Flat lay on a white towel: Moisture Layer Sunscreen, Sheer Glow BB, Glow Up Lip Oil, Set & Stay spray, in order left to right.
drafts_today.video_tip: 12-15s, bathroom window light: dot BB on forehead, cheeks, nose, chin; blend with fingertips; swipe lip oil; mist Set & Stay. Text: 'After 50, less is more'.

drafts_today.topic: Dry heat inside is hard on your ends too (botalab hair)
drafts_today.text:
Cold air outside. Dry heat inside.

My ends feel it as much as my cheeks.

What helps:
1. Warm water, not hot
2. Shampoo on the scalp, never the ends
3. Conditioner
4. 1-2 pumps of oil on mid-lengths and ends only

Mine: botalab Deserticola.

Where does winter hit your hair?
drafts_today.picture_tip: botalab Deserticola Plus Shampoo, Conditioner and Hair Oil Serum lined up on the edge of the tub, soft morning light.
drafts_today.video_tip: 8-10s: one pump of Hair Oil Serum into your palm, rub hands, smooth over the ends of your hair (not the roots). Text: 'Ends only'.
